onboarding.welcomeDesc:
A simple, privacy-first book tracker.

Your books stay in your own GitHub repository. Nothing is stored on our servers.
onboarding.githubDesc: Bookshelf syncs your book data through GitHub. All your books are stored in your own private repository.
onboarding.tokenDesc:
You'll need a Personal Access Token to authorize Bookshelf.

1. Go to github.com/settings/tokens
2. Click "Generate new token (classic)"
3. Give it a name (e.g., "Bookshelf")
4. Check "repo" scope
5. Click "Generate token"
6. Copy the token here
